messages.subject: [R-sig-Debian] [R] Ubuntu sources file for R packages
messages.subject_clean: Ubuntu sources file for R packages
messages.body_plain:
On 29 August 2026 at 08:50, Naresh Gurbuxani wrote:
| I followed these instructions to install R on my new Ubuntu desktop.
| 
| https://cran.r-project.org/bin/linux/ubuntu/
| 
| 
| To install additional packages, I am following these instructions:
| 
| https://cran.r-project.org/bin/linux/ubuntu/fullREADME.html
| 
| 
| For Ubuntu 26.04 (Resolute Racoon), /etc/apt/sources.list is 
| deprecated.? It seems I need to create a file in 
| /etc/apt/sources.list.d/.? I started a file "r-package.sources" and need 
| entries for the last two fields.? My file:
| 
| ## R package repository
| Types: deb
| URIs: https://cloud.r-project.org/bin/linux/ubuntu
| Suites: resolute-cran40
| Components:
| Signed-By:
| 
| It will also benefit other users if you can update the instructions in 
| fullREADME.html

Thanks. As the README says, this is by Michael (now CC'ed) and me, and
nowhere is it suggested to write to r-help. I see you also tried to
cross-post post to r-sig-debian (and first off, cross-posting is discouraged)
but this is bouncing until you become a list member (as I don't have time or
motivation to hand-approve posts given the spammers). I will remove r-help
from the recipient list now. Again if you want to reply there you first need
to do the 'handshake' via your email that follows sign-up.

For completeness, several places on the internet have sources for a current
26.04 'sources' entry, including my r2u project and its documentation,
scripts and Dockerfiles. There is also the `apt modernize-sources` command
for you.  Ubuntu (and Debian) do this every now and then just like the
preferred way to refer to a 'key' for validation changed.

Dirk

-- 
dirk.eddelbuettel.com | @eddelbuettel | edd at debian.org
